comment: Pinned portable toolchain for build.bat (read by web/windows/build-windows.ps1). Everything lands in tools/ at the repository root. A download is only used when its hash matches; 'hashSource' says where each hash came from. Never put a hash here that was not computed from the real file or published by its vendor.

tools.title: Python 3.12.10 (portable)
tools.hashSource: sha256: computed from the downloaded file. sha512: the packageHash nuget.org publishes for python 3.12.10 (https://api.nuget.org/v3/catalog0/data/2025.04.08.14.01.15/python.3.12.10.json, owner Python Software Foundation); both agree with the file.

tools.title: CMake 4.3.3
tools.hashSource: Kitware: https://github.com/Kitware/CMake/releases/download/v4.3.3/cmake-4.3.3-SHA-256.txt (also the pin in Launcher/Prepare-PortableTools.ps1); matches the downloaded file.

tools.title: Ninja 1.13.2
tools.hashSource: Computed from the downloaded release asset; equals the pin in Launcher/Prepare-PortableTools.ps1 (the ninja project publishes no checksum file).

tools.title: nodtool v2.0.0-alpha.10 (disc extractor)
tools.hashSource: Computed from the downloaded release asset (same release NODTOOL_VERSION / Launcher NodToolProvider.cs use); encounter/nod publishes no checksum file.
tools.name: nodtool.exe

tools.title: .NET SDK 8.0.425
tools.hashSource: Microsoft's release metadata: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dotnet/core/main/release-notes/8.0/releases.json (release 8.0.31, sdk 8.0.425, rid win-x64, dotnet-sdk-win-x64.zip, SHA-512). builds.dotnet.microsoft.com is not reachable from the authoring sandbox, so this download could not be re-hashed there.

tools.title: Emscripten SDK 6.0.12
tools.hashSource: Files: raw.githubusercontent.com/emscripten-core/emsdk at tag 6.0.12 (a GitHub /archive/ zip cannot be re-hashed reproducibly, so the files emsdk.py reads are pinned individually); sha256 computed from the downloaded files. Packages: the three downloads 'emsdk install 6.0.12' performs on Windows, fetched here ahead of it with resume and a hash check; sha256 computed from the files at storage.googleapis.com (Google publishes no checksums for them).

dotnetInstallScript.comment: Used only if the direct SDK download above fails. Pinned by content hash of the file served by raw.githubusercontent.com/dotnet/install-scripts/main; if Microsoft changes the script this hash will stop matching and the fallback is skipped (the direct download is the normal path).
